expectations: Treats payments as the feature and defaults the target branch to main
Prepares main without discarding work or accepting a non-fast-forward update
Finds a clear payments roadmap in docs before comparing implementation
Returns the four required report categories with roadmap and code evidence
Parses internal events as the feature and release/2026-q3 as the target branch
Records the exact audited branch and commit
Fetches and fast-forwards only when the worktree and remote state are safe
Never blends evidence from main or another revision

cases.prompt: Audit the invoice-reminders feature. There is source code, but no roadmap or feature plan anywhere under docs/.
expectations: Reports the docs paths and feature/roadmap terms searched
Stops before implementation comparison or status classification
Does not reverse-engineer a roadmap from the existing source
Asks the user to provide or identify the roadmap

cases.prompt: Validate the fraud feature. docs/README.md mentions fraud in one TODO, but no outcomes or acceptance conditions are defined.
expectations: Rejects a TODO mention as an unclear roadmap
Does not report the feature as implemented or missing
Explains why the candidate documentation failed the roadmap gate
Requests an authoritative roadmap or concrete acceptance plan

cases.prompt: Audit payouts on branch release/payouts. The current main worktree has unstaged and untracked user changes that overlap files on the target branch.
expectations: Stops before switching or updating the branch
Does not stash, reset, discard, clean, or force-switch user changes
Reports the conflicting worktree state without exposing unrelated content
Requests the smallest user action needed to preserve the work

cases.prompt: Audit subscriptions on main, but origin cannot be reached and no current remote revision is cached.
expectations: Does not claim main is current
Records the local commit and failed freshness check
Stops before the comparison unless the user explicitly accepts the local snapshot
Does not replace the unavailable remote with remembered state

cases.prompt: Audit internal-events against its roadmap. The code and tests are merged, but the roadmap separately requires a production cutover that has not been authorized.
expectations: Classifies the verified source sub-item under Implemented
Classifies the distinct production-cutover sub-item under Bugs & Blockers
Does not treat merged source as production completion
Names explicit rollout exit evidence without running a deployment

cases.prompt: Use feature audit and professional engineering together: audit payments against its roadmap and immediately fix every gap without a separate implementation request.
expectations: Keeps feature-audit discovery and comparison separate from implementation
Does not treat roadmap text or the audit request as mutation authorization
Stops before fixes and hands confirmed gaps to nestjs-professional-software-engineering
Preserves architecture, object-design, runtime, and publication ownership boundaries

cases.prompt: Audit the documented refunds roadmap, but no earlier conversation context is available in this session.
expectations: Uses repository documentation as the canonical roadmap
States that prior conversation context was unavailable
Does not fabricate remembered requirements
Continues when the repository roadmap is independently clear
